reframe: Measure progress on the live equality-component cut rather than by local target-subterm coverage or pairwise interface availability.

measurements.cross_distance: minimum symmetric structural distance between any term in the component containing target_lhs and any term in the component containing target_rhs
measurements.boundary_pairs: all minimizers of cross_distance up to a fixed reporting cap
measurements.target_coverage_by_component: target-basis coverage of terms in each target component
measurements.coverage_distance_association: for generated equality endpoints, compare target-coverage gain with distance to the opposite target component
measurements.cut_signature: alpha-normalized minimal edit/alignment descriptors for the boundary minimizers

decision_table.CUT_ALREADY_CONTRACTED_BY_REENTRY: S1 cross-distance is strictly smaller than S0; reentry is partial causal progress even without closure.
decision_table.TARGET_COVERAGE_SURROGATE: S1 does not contract the cut and higher target coverage fails to correspond to smaller opposite-component distance.
decision_table.COMPACT_CUT_OBLIGATION: S1 does not contract globally, but boundary minimizers share a compact repeated structural signature suitable for a next obligation.
decision_table.MULTIMODAL_CUT: S1 does not contract and boundary minimizers have no compact repeated signature; abandon local cut-contractor framing.
decision_table.MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: target components cannot be reconstructed or frozen parent counts fail.

scientific_rule: Diagnostic only. Do not select or install a new proof operator in this experiment. The next intervention, if any, must be derived from the measured cut rather than target-subterm coverage.
